items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: Walter Pichon, he's one of the piano player... he played here in St. Louis... I liked his style.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I don't mean Walter, Walter is a different piano player altogether from Steve, Steve Lewis I was speaking of.
I mean you mentioned the Pichon. Oh yeah, Pichon, oh yes.
